```{r setup, include=FALSE}

fmt <- function(x, digits = 3L) formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "f")
fmt_pct <- function(x, digits = 1L) paste0(fmt(100 * x, digits), "%")
fmt_p <- function(x) ifelse(is.finite(x), format.pval(x, digits = 3, eps = 1e-3), "NA")
fmt_ci <- function(x) paste0("[", fmt(x$ci_low), ", ", fmt(x$ci_high), "]")
analysis_name <- basename(.ablation03_path())
biology_input_script_name <- "01.03.00. 生物输入准备.R"

.wf_validate(result_dir)

structural_paths <- file.path(

  c(
    "structural_entity_audit.csv",
    "structural_pair_comparisons.csv",
    "structural_summary.csv",

  stop(
    "The structural reproducibility results are unavailable; run stage 07.",

}
structural_entity_audit <- read.csv(structural_paths[1L], check.names = FALSE)

structural_summary <- read.csv(structural_paths[3L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_matrices <- readRDS(structural_paths[4L])
structural_result <- readRDS(structural_paths[5L])
directional_paths <- file.path(

  directional_paths[1L], check.names = FALSE

structural_sample_audit <- read.csv(directional_paths[2L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_module_banks <- read.csv(directional_paths[3L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_matched_repeats <- read.csv(directional_paths[4L], check.names = FALSE)
structural_matched_summary <- read.csv(directional_paths[5L], check.names = FALSE)
table_dir <- .ablation03_report_path("tables")
dir.create(table_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
utils::write.csv(
  structural_directional_summary,
  file.path(table_dir, "02.03.00. directional-summary.csv"),

structural_functions_name <-
  "02.03.00. 结构复现分析_functions.R"
structural_all <- structural_summary[
  structural_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_same_cancer <- structural_summary[
  structural_summary$scope == "same_cancer_type",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_same_cancer_pair_count <- if (nrow(structural_same_cancer) == 1L) {
  structural_same_cancer$cohort_pair_count
} else {
  0L
}
structural_same_cancer_summary <- if (
  nrow(structural_same_cancer) == 1L &&
    identical(structural_same_cancer$inference_status, "estimable")
) {
  paste0(
    "达到预设推断门槛，平均差为 ",
    fmt(structural_same_cancer$mean_delta, 4L),
    "，节点 bootstrap 区间为 [",
    fmt(structural_same_cancer$mean_delta_ci_low, 4L), ", ",
    fmt(structural_same_cancer$mean_delta_ci_high, 4L), "]"

} else if (nrow(structural_same_cancer) == 1L) {
  paste0(
    "未达到至少 4 个 cohort 且 3 个队列对的预设推断门槛；",
    "平均差 ", fmt(structural_same_cancer$mean_delta, 4L),
    " 仅作描述"
  )
} else {
  "没有形成可比较的同癌种队列对"
}
structural_forward_all <- structural_directional_summary[
  structural_directional_summary$direction ==
    "reference_bank_to_external_targets" &
    structural_directional_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_reverse_all <- structural_directional_summary[
  structural_directional_summary$direction ==
    "external_bank_to_reference_targets" &
    structural_directional_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_matched_all <- structural_matched_repeats[
  structural_matched_repeats$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_matched_all$direction_label <- factor(
  structural_matched_all$direction,
  levels = c(
    "reference_bank_to_external_targets",
    "external_bank_to_reference_targets"
  ),
  labels = c(
    "Reference modules\non external targets",
    "External modules\non reference targets"
  )
)
structural_reference_modules <- sum(
  structural_module_banks$bank_role == "reference"
)
structural_external_modules <- sum(
  structural_module_banks$bank_role == "external"
)
structural_matched_modules <- unique(
  structural_matched_summary$bank_module_count
)[1L]
structural_matched_forward_all <- structural_matched_summary[
  structural_matched_summary$direction ==
    "reference_bank_to_external_targets" &
    structural_matched_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_matched_reverse_all <- structural_matched_summary[
  structural_matched_summary$direction ==
    "external_bank_to_reference_targets" &
    structural_matched_summary$scope == "all_cohort_pairs",
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_direction_rank <- rbind(
  transform(structural_forward_all, direction_label = "reference→external"),
  transform(structural_reverse_all, direction_label = "external→reference")
)
structural_direction_top <- structural_direction_rank[
  which.max(abs(structural_direction_rank$mean_delta)),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_best <- structural_pairs[
  which.max(structural_pairs$delta_d1_minus_direct),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_worst <- structural_pairs[
  which.min(structural_pairs$delta_d1_minus_direct),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
structural_paired_long <- rbind(
  data.frame(
    pair_id = seq_len(nrow(structural_pairs)),
    representation = "Direct-GSClassifier",
    similarity = structural_pairs$direct_similarity
  ),
  data.frame(
    pair_id = seq_len(nrow(structural_pairs)),
    representation = "Cohort-d1",
    similarity = structural_pairs$d1_similarity
  )
)
structural_paired_long$representation <- factor(
  structural_paired_long$representation,
  levels = c("Direct-GSClassifier", "Cohort-d1")
)
structural_cohorts <- rownames(structural_matrices[["Direct-GSClassifier"]])
structural_labels <- sub("/TCGATARGET-", "/TCGA-", structural_cohorts)
structural_labels <- gsub("/", "\n", structural_labels, fixed = TRUE)
names(structural_labels) <- structural_cohorts
structural_matrix_long <- function(matrix, representation) {
  data <- as.data.frame(as.table(matrix), responseName = "similarity")
  names(data)[1:2] <- c("cohort_a", "cohort_b")
  data$representation <- representation
  data$cohort_a <- factor(
    data$cohort_a,
    levels = structural_cohorts,
    labels = unname(structural_labels[structural_cohorts])
  )
  data$cohort_b <- factor(
    data$cohort_b,
    levels = rev(structural_cohorts),
    labels = unname(structural_labels[rev(structural_cohorts)])
  )
  data
}
structural_direct_heatmap <- structural_matrix_long(
  structural_matrices[["Direct-GSClassifier"]],
  "Direct-GSClassifier"
)
structural_d1_heatmap <- structural_matrix_long(
  structural_matrices[["Cohort-d1"]],
  "Cohort-d1"
)

figure_dir <- .ablation03_report_path("figures")
dir.create(figure_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
preview_dir <- bensz_run_dir(bensz_preview_root(params$plot_run_dir),
  prefix = "02.03.00-structural-reproducibility")
```

本报告是 `r analysis_name` 实验的结构可复现性模块；读取双向投影与 matched-bank 分析结果，不运行模型计算。

## 数据概览

reference 与 external bank 分别包含 `r structural_reference_modules` 和 `r structural_external_modules` 个模块。正向有效队列对为 `r structural_all$cohort_pair_count` 对；共享 cohort 的队列对并非独立重复。

## 关键函数、参数与源代码位置

| 过程 | 函数与参数 | 约定 | 源代码 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 结构表达输入 | `.asr_extract_anchor_cache()` | 准备阶段固定完整样本范围和 signature | `r biology_input_script_name` |
| 生物状态 | `.asr_assign_anchor_states()`；两端各三分之一 | 每实体至少 `r structural_result$method$min_entity_n` 个样本；并列边界不强制分组 | `r structural_functions_name` |
| 双向推断 | `.asr_evaluate_direction()`；cohort-node bootstrap | 保留 reference→external 与 external→reference 的原设计 | `r structural_script_name` |
| 匹配敏感性 | `.asr_matched_bank_design()`；`r unique(structural_matched_forward_all$repeat_count)` 次重复 | 同 tissue、同模块预算；范围不作为置信区间 | `r structural_functions_name` |

## 指标导读

| 指标 | 定义与边界 |
|---|---|
| 结构相似度 | 同一组高低状态的质心距离在跨队列之间的 Spearman；越高表示距离排序越可复现 |
| d1−Direct | 同一个队列对的结构相似度差；不能独自证明无信息损失 |
| `r "95%"` CI | 至少 `r 4L` 个 cohort 且 `r 3L` 个队列对时使用 cohort 节点 bootstrap；否则仅保留描述性点估计 |
| Matched-bank 范围 | 固定目标数据下改变 bank 组成的敏感性；不是抽样置信区间 |

## 独立队列间的生物结构可复现性

每个目标 cohort 内按 anchor 分数取两端三分之一，形成八个相对高低状态；每个状态至少 `r structural_result$method$min_entity_n` 个样本。常量分数或分位边界并列时不强行切分。各表示先计算状态质心之间的距离，再比较不同 cohort 的距离排序。

正向使用 reference d1 modules 投影 external targets，反向使用 external d1 modules 投影 reference targets。**反向 Direct 仍沿用正向的冻结特征合同**，只交换尺度拟合侧；反向结果因此是固定 Direct 基准下的敏感性检查，不是两臂所有特征选择步骤都重新外部化的对称验证。

```{r structural-directional-summary, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
render_dt(
  structural_directional_summary[, c(
    "direction", "bank_role", "target_role", "scope",
    "bank_module_count", "bank_feature_count", "fit_sample_count",
    "target_sample_count", "cohort_count", "cohort_pair_count",
    "mean_direct_similarity", "mean_d1_similarity", "mean_delta",
    "fraction_d1_ge_direct", "mean_delta_ci_low", "mean_delta_ci_high",
    "inference_status"
  )],
  pageLength = 4L
)
```

解读：当前结果显示，正向和反向平均 d1−Direct 结构差分别为 `r fmt(structural_forward_all$mean_delta, 4L)` 和 `r fmt(structural_reverse_all$mean_delta, 4L)`。方向之间同时改变了 target 集合和 bank 组成，不宜直接把两者大小解释成某个方向天然更优。分向表展示的是两组不同目标队列上的结构差异，提示外部性首先取决于使用哪一侧的模型。反向检查扩大了设计信息，但共同使用冻结 Direct 合同意味着两方向并非交换所有学习步骤后的完全对称实验。

```{r structural-entity-audit, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
render_dt(structural_entity_audit, pageLength = 12)
```

解读：当前结果显示，正向共有 `r structural_all$cohort_count` 个 cohort 进入有效队列对比较，候选总数为 `r manifest$external_candidate_cohort_count`。表中记录有效状态的样本与基因数；应核查候选到有效集合的差异，而不能预设所有候选都满足状态资格。该表展示有效实体的构造范围，提示高低状态首先是队列内部的相对位置。样本不足或边界并列会使某些状态不可估计；这种排除应与候选范围一起报告，不能将其当作跨平台统一阈值或绝对生物状态。

```{r structural-pair-table, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
render_dt(
  structural_pairs[, c(
    "cohort_a", "cohort_b", "cancer_type_a", "cancer_type_b",
    "same_cancer_type", "shared_entity_count", "compared_distance_count",
    "direct_similarity", "d1_similarity", "delta_d1_minus_direct"
  )],
  pageLength = 12
)
```

解读：当前结果显示，正向共有 `r structural_all$cohort_pair_count` 个有效队列对，改善最大与下降最大差值分别为 `r fmt(structural_best$delta_d1_minus_direct)` 和 `r fmt(structural_worst$delta_d1_minus_direct)`。这些行共享 cohort，不能当作相互独立的实验重复。表中展示的是同一批生物实体在不同队列中的距离排序差异。某个队列反复出现在许多行中，提示这些行之间共享信息；最大正负差适合定位敏感队列，但不能被当作额外增加的独立统计证据。

```{r figure-structural-paired, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 11: Cross-cohort structural similarity (user-adjustable parameters) ====
fig11 <- list(
  # Canvas size (inches). Increase width for longer representation labels;
  # increase height if the similarity distribution looks compressed.
  width_in = 5.8,
  height_in = 4.8,
  # Base font size (pt). Values around 10-12 remain readable in print.
  base_size = 11,
  # Thin translucent lines retain paired comparisons without forming a dark wall.
  pair_line_width = 0.35,
  pair_alpha = 0.20,
  # Point size/alpha balance individual visibility against overplotting.
  point_size = 1.8,
  point_alpha = 0.62,
  # Median diamonds are larger so the central shift remains visible.
  median_size = 3.2,
  # Preserve the full correlation range so negative similarities remain visible.
  y_limits = c(-1, 1),
  legend_position = "none"
)
structural_medians <- stats::aggregate(
  similarity ~ representation,
  data = structural_paired_long,
  FUN = stats::median
)
p11 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  structural_paired_long,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$representation,
    y = .data$similarity,
    group = .data$pair_id
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_line(
    linewidth = fig11$pair_line_width,
    alpha = fig11$pair_alpha,
    color = "grey55"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    ggplot2::aes(color = .data$representation),
    size = fig11$point_size,
    alpha = fig11$point_alpha
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = structural_medians,
    ggplot2::aes(
      x = .data$representation,
      y = .data$similarity
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 23,
    size = fig11$median_size,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(values = c(
    `Direct-GSClassifier` = nature_colors[["blue"]],
    `Cohort-d1` = nature_colors[["orange"]]
  )) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = fig11$y_limits,
    breaks = seq(fig11$y_limits[1L], fig11$y_limits[2L], 0.25)
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Cross-cohort structural similarity (Spearman)"
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(
    base_size = fig11$base_size,
    x_text_angle = 0,
    legend_position = fig11$legend_position
  )

# Readability check: low-alpha lines prevent cohort pairs from obscuring one
# another, median diamonds expose the central shift, and the full correlation
# range retains negative estimates without clipping values.
fig11_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
  p11, "02.03.00. structural-reproducibility-paired", figure_dir,
  preview_dir, fig11, params$plot_preview_dpi
)
knitr::include_graphics(fig11_jpg)
```

解读：当前结果显示，Direct 与 d1 的平均跨队列结构相似度分别为 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_direct_similarity)` 和 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_d1_similarity)`，配对平均差为 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_delta, 4L)`，cohort-node bootstrap 95% CI 为 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_delta_ci_low, 4L)` 至 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_delta_ci_high, 4L)`。这量化了结构差异，但没有预设容许损失界值，不能据此宣称等价或非劣效。连线展示同一个队列对更换表示后的差异，提示平均趋势与局部异质性需要同时考虑。即便平均值接近，也可能存在少数变化较大的队列；若要讨论结构保留，应结合绝对相似度、区间和预先确定的容许损失。

```{r figure-structural-direct-heatmap, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 12: Direct structural-similarity heatmap (user-adjustable parameters) ====
fig12 <- list(
  # Enlarged canvas leaves room for the complete cohort labels on both axes.
  width_in = 14,
  height_in = 13,
  # Base font and tile border sizes preserve labels and cell boundaries in print.
  base_size = 9,
  tile_line_width = 0.18,
  # A 45-degree x label avoids overlap; the legend stays outside the data grid.
  x_text_angle = 45,
  # Both panels share -1 to 1 so all correlations have a common scale; this supports
  # visible contrast while preserving direct cellwise comparability.
  fill_limits = c(-1, 1),
  fill_midpoint = 0,
  legend_position = "right"
)
p12 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  structural_direct_heatmap,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x = .data$cohort_a,
    y = .data$cohort_b,
    fill = .data$similarity
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(
    color = "white",
    linewidth = fig12$tile_line_width
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = nature_colors[["blue"]],
    mid = "white",
    high = nature_colors[["red"]],
    midpoint = fig12$fill_midpoint,
    limits = fig12$fill_limits,
    name = "Spearman"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Cohort", y = "Cohort") +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
  theme_nature_readable(
    base_size = fig12$base_size,
    x_text_angle = fig12$x_text_angle,
    legend_position = fig12$legend_position
  )

# Readability check: cohort labels are shortened only for display and wrapped
# onto two lines; a square grid, external legend, and fixed color scale avoid
# clipping and make this panel directly comparable with Figure 13.
fig12_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
  p12, "02.03.00. structural-similarity-direct", figure_dir,
  preview_dir, fig12, params$plot_preview_dpi
)
knitr::include_graphics(fig12_jpg)
```

解读：当前结果显示，Direct 的平均结构相似度为 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_direct_similarity)`。热图展示跨 cohort 的异质性；它与下一幅 d1 图使用相同色阶，逐格比较时不会因自动缩放产生视觉差异。图中展示不同队列对的基线一致性，提示 Direct 本身是否已经具有较高的结构复现程度。红蓝差异只对应相似度，不表示某个队列具有更好的临床状态；比较时应固定实体集合与色阶，避免将图形颜色当作额外统计检验。

```{r figure-structural-d1-heatmap, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 13: d1 structural-similarity heatmap (user-adjustable parameters) ====
# Reuse the exact Figure 12 dimensions, typography, and color limits so visual
# differences reflect data rather than plotting choices.
fig13 <- fig12
p13 <- ggplot2::ggplot(

    mid = "white",
    high = nature_colors[["red"]],
    midpoint = fig13$fill_midpoint,
    limits = fig13$fill_limits,
    name = "Spearman"
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Cohort", y = "Cohort") +
  ggplot2::coord_fixed() +
  theme_nature_readable(
    base_size = fig13$base_size,
    x_text_angle = fig13$x_text_angle,
    legend_position = fig13$legend_position
  )

# Readability check: Figure 13 deliberately shares Figure 12's label wrapping,
# square aspect, external legend, and common -1 to 1 scale, enabling cellwise visual
# comparison without rescaling artifacts.
fig13_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
  p13, "02.03.00. structural-similarity-d1", figure_dir,
  preview_dir, fig13, params$plot_preview_dpi
)
knitr::include_graphics(fig13_jpg)
```

解读：当前结果显示，d1 的平均结构相似度为 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_d1_similarity)`，相对 Direct 的平均差为 `r fmt(structural_all$mean_delta, 4L)`。颜色反映八个相对状态的距离排序相似度，不代表所有分子信息或临床信息被保留。这张图展示 d1 的同一组队列比较，提示表示改变可能并非均匀作用于所有队列。与前图逐格对照可以定位差异来源，但热图本身没有处理多重检验，因此正式推断仍以节点重采样的总体效应区间为依据。

```{r structural-summary-table, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
render_dt(
  structural_summary[, c(
    "scope", "cohort_count", "cohort_pair_count",
    "mean_direct_similarity", "median_direct_similarity",
    "mean_d1_similarity", "median_d1_similarity", "mean_delta",
    "median_delta", "fraction_d1_ge_direct", "mean_delta_ci_low",
    "mean_delta_ci_high", "inference_method", "inference_status",
    "min_inference_cohorts", "min_inference_pairs", "p_value_reason"
  )],
  pageLength = 5
)
```

解读：当前结果显示，同癌种的有效队列对有 `r structural_same_cancer_pair_count` 对；`r structural_same_cancer_summary`。该子集用于限制癌种构成的影响；只有达到门槛时，节点 bootstrap 才用于保留共享 cohort 的依赖关系。表格展示全体与同癌种子集的差异，提示组织背景可能影响整体地图的一致性。同癌种检查减少了一种组成差异，但没有消除平台、采样和疾病阶段的影响；样本范围较窄时也不能外推到全部癌种。

```{r figure-structural-matched-bank, interp_check=TRUE}
# ==== Figure 14: Reciprocal matched-bank sensitivity (user-adjustable parameters) ====
fig14 <- list(
  # Wide canvas leaves room for two-line direction labels and the external legend.
  width_in = 7.2,
  height_in = 4.8,
  # Base font remains legible in print; jitter exposes all 20 bank repeats.
  base_size = 11,
  point_size = 2.0,
  point_alpha = 0.72,
  jitter_width = 0.10,
  jitter_seed = 20260912L,
  box_width = 0.42,
  full_point_size = 4.0,
  zero_line_width = 0.55,
  legend_position = "bottom"
)
structural_full_direction <- data.frame(
  direction_label = factor(
    c(
      "reference_bank_to_external_targets",
      "external_bank_to_reference_targets"
    ),
    levels = c(
      "reference_bank_to_external_targets",
      "external_bank_to_reference_targets"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "Reference modules\non external targets",
      "External modules\non reference targets"
    )
  ),
  mean_delta = c(
    structural_forward_all$mean_delta,
    structural_reverse_all$mean_delta
  )
)
p14 <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  structural_matched_all,
  ggplot2::aes(x = .data$direction_label, y = .data$mean_delta)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0,
    linewidth = fig14$zero_line_width,
    color = "grey55"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_boxplot(
    width = fig14$box_width,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    fill = "grey92",
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(
    ggplot2::aes(color = .data$bank_role),
    position = ggplot2::position_jitter(
      width = fig14$jitter_width,
      height = 0,
      seed = fig14$jitter_seed
    ),
    size = fig14$point_size,
    alpha = fig14$point_alpha
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    data = structural_full_direction,
    ggplot2::aes(x = .data$direction_label, y = .data$mean_delta),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    shape = 23,
    size = fig14$full_point_size,
    fill = "white",
    color = "black",
    stroke = 0.9
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      reference = nature_colors[["blue"]],
      external = nature_colors[["orange"]]
    ),
    labels = c(reference = "Reference modules", external = "External modules")
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean similarity difference (d1 - Direct)",
    color = "Matched module bank",
    caption = "Points: 22-module matched-bank repeats; diamonds: complete banks."
  ) +
  theme_nature_readable(
    base_size = fig14$base_size,
    x_text_angle = 0,
    legend_position = fig14$legend_position
  )

# Readability check: two short direction labels prevent clipping, jitter keeps
# all repeats visible, the zero line fixes direction, and outlined diamonds
# distinguish complete-bank estimates from matched design sensitivity.
fig14_jpg <- .ae_save_plot(
  p14, "02.03.00. structural-matched-bank-sensitivity", figure_dir,
  preview_dir, fig14, params$plot_preview_dpi
)
knitr::include_graphics(fig14_jpg)
```

解读：当前结果显示，每侧使用 `r structural_matched_modules` 个 tissue-matched modules，共 `r unique(structural_matched_forward_all$repeat_count)` 次重复。图中分散程度描述更换 bank 组成后效应如何变化；这不是目标 cohort 抽样置信区间。这些点展示重复匹配后的设计差异，提示完整 bank 的方向差可能受到模块预算和组成共同影响。范围较宽说明 bank 选择敏感；范围较窄只表明本次匹配策略下较稳定，并不能替代对新目标队列的验证。

```{r structural-matched-summary-table, echo=FALSE, interp_check=TRUE}
render_dt(
  structural_matched_summary[, c(
    "direction", "scope", "repeat_count", "bank_module_count",
    "mean_delta_median", "mean_delta_min", "mean_delta_max",
    "mean_direct_similarity_median", "mean_d1_similarity_median",
    "fraction_d1_ge_direct_median", "range_interpretation"
  )],
  pageLength = 4L
)
```

解读：当前结果显示，正向 matched-bank 效应中位数为 `r fmt(structural_matched_forward_all$mean_delta_median, 4L)`，反向为 `r fmt(structural_matched_reverse_all$mean_delta_median, 4L)`。相同 module 数限制了预算差异，但仍不能消除两方向 target 集合与 Direct 特征确定来源的不同。汇总表展示了每个方向在重复 bank 设计下的效应分布，提示同预算比较仍有剩余限制。最小和最大值来自有限次数的设计探索，它们不是概率覆盖区间，也不应据此给出对所有可能 bank 的保证。

## 讨论与分析

当前结果显示，正向与反向的平均结构差分别为 `r fmt(structural_forward_all$mean_delta, 4L)` 和 `r fmt(structural_reverse_all$mean_delta, 4L)`。两方向同时改变 bank 与 target，且共享冻结 Direct 合同，因此不能把方向差直接解释为互换全部学习步骤后的对称验证。

当前结果显示，最强信号来自 `r structural_direction_top$direction_label`，其平均 d1−Direct 差为 `r fmt(structural_direction_top$mean_delta, 4L)`；这里的“最强”只按当前两方向的绝对差排序，不代表确认性优势。

当前结果显示，每侧 `r structural_matched_modules` 个模块的重复匹配中，正向与反向效应中位数分别为 `r fmt(structural_matched_forward_all$mean_delta_median, 4L)` 和 `r fmt(structural_matched_reverse_all$mean_delta_median, 4L)`，用于描述 bank 组成敏感性。若要主张结构基本保留，应预先定义可接受的损失界值，再在独立 cohort 上检验；当前正向 CI 为 `r paste0("[", fmt(structural_forward_all$mean_delta_ci_low, 4L), ", ", fmt(structural_forward_all$mean_delta_ci_high, 4L), "]")`，反向 CI 为 `r paste0("[", fmt(structural_reverse_all$mean_delta_ci_low, 4L), ", ", fmt(structural_reverse_all$mean_delta_ci_high, 4L), "]")`，这些区间和有限设计范围都不能证明等价或非劣效。

## 数字准确性验证

| 核查 | 当前证据 |
|---|---|
| 来源 | 结构结果及表示/输入准备的凭据逐项核验 |
| 外部性 | bank 样本与 target 样本无重叠，见分向 sample audit |
| 独立单位 | cohort 节点而非队列对 |
| 敏感性 | matched-bank 范围保留原有解释，不冒充置信区间 |
| 数字 | 所有内联效应与图表均读取当前 CSV/RDS |
